events.subtitle: Birthday Premium Live 2026
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Saki Takaoka's Birthday Premium Live 2026 on Thursday, December 3, 2026, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The official event page lists Takaoka on vocals with Akira Ishiguro on guitar, Mao Sone on piano and trumpet, Katsuhito 'P' Koizumi on bass, and Toyoaki Sekine on drums, and describes a repertoire spanning jazz and pop. Takaoka returned to sustained singing activity in 2013 and has since released work crossing jazz, bossa nova and city pop; Victor's Decade -Sings Cinematic- compiles that post-return period.

en.why_it_matters: This earns a RADAR slot because Takaoka's second life as a singer is stranger and more musically connected than a simple actor-to-cabaret detour. Since returning seriously to music, she has worked through jazz, bossa nova and city-pop language, and this COTTON CLUB band gives that thread real instrumental weight: Ishiguro on guitar, Sone moving between piano and trumpet, plus a compact bass-and-drums rhythm section. The appeal is hearing a Japanese pop-cultural figure inside a working club-band frame rather than a large nostalgia production.
en.trip_verdict: Keep it on the board if December 3 is open in Tokyo. The band and small-room setting make it a worthwhile Japan-side discovery, but the birthday-live format is recurring, so I would fit it around rarer masters, premieres, reunions or one-off contexts rather than move an anchor date to make room.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta merece un lugar en el RADAR porque la segunda vida musical de Takaoka es bastante más interesante que el típico salto de actriz a cabaret. Desde que retomó en serio el canto ha trabajado entre jazz, bossa y city pop, y esta banda de COTTON CLUB le da peso instrumental real a ese hilo: Ishiguro en guitarra, Sone alternando piano y trompeta, más una sección rítmica compacta de bajo y batería. Lo interesante es escuchar a una figura de la cultura pop japonesa dentro de una lógica de banda de club, no de una gran producción nostálgica.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero si el 3 de diciembre está libre en Tokio. La banda y la escala pequeña del club la vuelven una buena captura del lado japonés del RADAR, pero el formato de birthday live es recurrente; la acomodaría alrededor de maestros más raros, estrenos, reuniones o contextos de una sola fecha en vez de mover una fecha-ancla para hacerle espacio.
